statement: The EXP-0023 maintainer reports repeated sequential ALSA playback and human-confirmed routing: channel 1 left headphones, channel 2 right headphones, channel 3 left grip actuator, channel 4 right grip actuator. These subjective observations do not quantify crosstalk, timing, level, or headset microphone routing. An attempted onboard-speaker check without explicit HID routing did not establish audible speaker output; headset capture transferred but meaningful input response was not established.

applicability.scope: Cited maintainer lab narrative; physical corroboration cannot be promoted without an accepted structured experiment and artifact.
